note: Independent re-judgment at HEAD against RFC 6811 Section 2 ('The validation state of the Route MUST be set to reflect the result of the lookup.'). Verified rpki/rpki.go::validateNLRIs queries rp.cache.Validate(prefix, originAS) and forwards the lookup state in validationRequest to adj_rib_in, which records ValidationState on stored routes. Positives cover Route Origin ASN derivation from AS_PATH (TestRPKIOriginASFromASPathRFC6811), ROACache.Validate lookup (TestValidateValid), validateNLRIs setting returned and queued states for all three outcomes Valid/Invalid/NotFound (TestRouteStateIsSetFromTheLookup), and adj_rib_in preserving Valid and policy-accepted Invalid states on string and typed batch paths (TestBatchValidateTypedMatchesString). Negatives prove Invalid on unauthorized origin AS (TestValidateInvalid), AS_SET -> OriginNone and empty -> localAS (TestRPKIOriginASFromASPathRFC6811#2), and a VRP change flipping Valid to Invalid is not masked by prior state (TestRouteStateIsSetFromTheLookup#2). Q1-Q4 pass.
